snippet.title: Roco Kingdom | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
From the Magic Academy to the vast, vibrant world beyond — discover the secrets of Jinies, explore the world they call home, and maybe even find your true calling.

Roco Kingdom is a new evolution of open-world creature-collecting games, where players become Rocos and set out to meet Jinies, the native creatures living on the continent of Carosia.

Sign-ups for our Closed Beta, the Quack Quack Test, are now open: https://www.rocokingdom.com

✦ Wishlist us now ✦
Steam: https://rocokingdom.com/steam/
PlayStation: https://rocokingdom.com/ps/
Epic: https://rocokingdom.com/epic/
Xbox: https://rocokingdom.com/xbox/
